reasons.claim: The gap phrase after al-Rayyan is an unnamed link.
Abu al-Hasan, after «عن», speaks the saying and is the last link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ

reasons.claim: The father is one link written with his name.
Ibn Abbas speaks the words and is the last link; the son is only addressed.
reasons.quote: سمعت عبد الله بن عباس يقول لابنه علي بن عبد الله

reasons.claim: The first saying runs through the Imam and his forefathers to the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن أبي جعفر الباقر عن آبائه

reasons.claim: The date of the copy is not a link.
reasons.quote: من كتابه سنة ثلاث وسبعين ومائتين

reasons.claim: Abu Ja'far himself speaks a second saying inside the narrated encounter, so under rulings 9 and 10 it keeps its own route ending at him.
reasons.quote: فأقبل عليه أبو جعفر فقال له: أما والله

groups.saying_opens: إنّ مِن أهل بيتي اثنا عشر محدّثاً

levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد بن عقدة الكوفي

groups.saying_opens: أما والله إنّ ابن أمّك كان كذلك

levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد بن عقدة الكوفي

notes: second saying: Abu Ja'far's reply in the story (rulings 9, 10)

reviews.uncertainty_note: Whether the Imam's reply in the scene counts as a second saying under ruling 9 or merely as part of the one report is a judgement of wording.

reasons.claim: The father is one link by his name, and the elided route is an unnamed gap at its place before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه محمد بن خالد باسناده يرفعه

reasons.claim: The grandfather tells an encounter in which Umar is present.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه، عن جده، قال: وقع رجل في علي بن أبي طالب بمحضر من عمر بن الخطاب

reasons.claim: Umar speaks the words the report relays, so under ruling 9 he is the last link after the grandfather.
reasons.quote: فقال له عمر: تعرف صاحب هذا القبر

levels.surface: الحسين بن يحيى بن ضريس البجلي
محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن عروة بن الزبير

notes: Umar speaks inside the narrated encounter (ruling 9)

reviews.uncertainty_note: The grandfather's own narration of the scene could be read as the relayed report, but Umar's speech is its substance.

reasons.claim: Ali b. al-Fadl heard Abu Umar, who is asked and answers, so he is the last link.
The answer is Abu Umar's own words.

reviews.question: a source known only by a title (the cited book al-Khisal)

reasons.claim: The book title and section are not transmitters; the Imam named speaks and is the only link either way the title question goes.
reasons.quote: الخصال: في حديث الأربعمائة: قال أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام

reviews.question: the Prophet speaking a one-sentence report with no transmitter

reasons.claim: The report is a bare saying with no transmitter and no speaker written.
«ح» opens a second branch from the compiler.
reasons.quote: ح وأخبرني أحمد بن محمد بن المغيرة

reasons.claim: The names after the second Mu'awiya are written once and close both branches, ending at Abd Allah who heard the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن يحيى بن أبي كثير، أن أبا سلمة، أخبره أنه، سمع عبد الله

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters reach al-Layth, «ح» adds Qutayba to Layth, and the tail after him is shared by all three routes.
reasons.quote: قالا أخبرنا الليث، ح وحدثنا قتيبة بن، سعيد حدثنا ليث، عن ابن شهاب
